title: Smart traffic pauser with gradual signal decay and cost-aware sentinels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Current canary and A/B rollout controllers often rely on fixed thresholds for latency/error/token-cost/throughput. Fixed thresholds either cause noisy false positives during traffic spikes or are too lax and delay evacuation, increasing customer impact and cost. We need an adaptive, multi-signal pausing/evacuation mechanism that reduces blast radius without manual tuning.
goal: Deliver a traffic pauser service integrated into the rollout controller that: 1) ingests multiple SLO signals (p50/p90/p99 latency, error rate, token cost per request, throughput); 2) computes a unified risk score using derivative and variance-aware heuristics; 3) supports cohort baselines and cost-normalized thresholds; 4) exposes tunable hysteresis and staged pausing (soft pause, slow-rollout, full stop); and 5) provides observability, simulation, and canary/AB/shadow-aware probes.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can ingest at least 4 signals for each canary: latency (p50/p90), error-rate, and token-cost per request
Unified risk score computed and stored for each canary with configurable weights
Automated action pipeline supports three actions: soft-throttle (reduce %) , pause-canary, and evacuate (route 100% back)
False positive rate in historical replay reduced by >= 30% vs fixed-threshold policy for three sampled workloads
Console shows per-canary risk score, contributing signals, and suggested rollback action
Feature includes a simulation harness (10k synthetic rollouts) and a replay mode for past incidents
design_notes: Core heuristics: (a) Use short-window derivatives to detect sudden degradations (d/dt metrics) and long-window baseline drift for seasonality. (b) Normalize token-cost signals by expected token distribution per-model and per-route; convert cost into an anomaly z-score rather than absolute dollars. (c) Fuse signals using a weighted logistic scoring function with weight priors per-customer tier and a confidence multiplier derived from sample size. (d) Apply cohort-specific baselines (e.g., mobile vs desktop, region) and require correlated signal elevation across >=2 cohorts to escalate to evacuate. (e) Hysteresis: require sustained risk > threshold for configured hold period before aggressive actions; use exponential decay to avoid flip-flopping during bursty traffic. (f) Provide an override channel for SRE and on-call to force-pause or mark safe.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): instrumentation and telemetry: add standardized metric envelopes for token-cost and throughput to the rollout controller, implement short/long sliding windows in metrics-collector, create an offline simulator to replay historic traffic. Phase 2 (3 sprints): build risk-scoring service (stateless microservice) that ingests envelopes, computes derivatives, cohort baselines, z-scores, and a fused risk; integrate with controller action API. Phase 3 (2 sprints): UI/console changes to surface scores, add canary policy schema for staged actions, and implement audit logging. Phase 4 (1 sprint): internal dogfood on dedicated pool and run controlled A/B tests vs current policy, tune defaults, prepare runbook and KB.
tasks: Add token-cost telemetry hook to serving runtime (ENG-280001)
Extend metrics collector with dual-window derivative calculator
Risk scoring microservice: proto + API + unit tests
Integrate action API with rollout controller; implement soft-throttle and pause
Replay harness: ingest 6 months of production metrics for 3 representative routes
Console: risk score panel and traceback to contributing metrics
Runbook: operational playbook and SRE training session
Simulation: generate 10k synthetic canaries and measure false positive/negative rates
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overreaction to short bursts => Mitigation: require correlated signals and apply hold windows + exponential decay
Risk: Metric noise for low-traffic cohorts => Mitigation: confidence multiplier and min-sample thresholds; fall back to global baseline
Risk: Increased complexity for customers configuring policies => Mitigation: provide sensible defaults and templated policies per workload
Risk: Cost signal manipulation (e.g., billing spikes) => Mitigation: normalize by model/route token distributions and cross-check with throughput anomalies
observability_requirements: Per-canary time-series for each raw signal (latency p50/p90/p99, error-rate, token-cost, throughput)
Audit trail for every automated action (who/what/why)
Simulation dashboards showing replay mismatch and FPR/FNR vs baseline
ui_changes: Add a "risk insights" section to canary detail page: risk score sparkline, top-3 contributing signals, suggested action (soft-throttle/pause/evacuate), and a 'simulate' button to run historical replay for this route.
security_considerations: Audit logs must be forwarded to customer-managed KMS-backed storage for Private deployments. Ensure the action API requires RBAC checks and MFA on forced evacuations for high-privilege roles.
rollout_strategy: Start as an opt-in feature for internal teams (dogfood) on non-critical tenants. After 2-week stability and tuning, enable for 'beta' customers. Use shadow traffic comparisons and A/B tests to validate behavior before global enablement. Provide an emergency global kill-switch in control plane.
metrics_to_track: False positive rate on historical replays
Mean time to evacuate after real incident
Cost delta attributable to automatic pause actions
Number of manual overrides by SRE
